context.description: Add the run header with the spec title from structured metadata

evidence.trustReason: Trust rejected — one test case lacks a meaningful assertion: the TUI UserMessage (UI6, routes/session/index.tsx). TaskHeader is render-tested well (muted lead-in, bold title in the text tone, word wrap with no cut, muted left-out line), but UserMessage itself is covered only by a source check of three substrings. It does not pin the visibility guard <Show when={text() || header()}> nor the <Show when={header()}> wrapper. The whole-spec first message has one part, the header; splitHeader removes it from texts, so text() is empty. Reverting the guard to <Show when={text()}> hides the run header from the transcript and every test stays green. Verifier evidence: the test's three assertions applied to in-memory mutants of index.tsx — guard reverted, header Show disabled (false && header()), header text drawn raw — all three survive; the builder sweep t4.10-mutants.py never mutates index.tsx. Fix: move the message-body decision into task-header.tsx as an exported component and render-test a header-only part list, header plus SV26 note, and a plain message; or at minimum pin the guard and wrapper in the source check and add index.tsx mutants. Minor: no negative case gives splitHeader a header-looking text with no metadata (never parses text). Other cases covered and strong: whole-spec exact parts+metadata+noReply via TaskCommand.run (UI6); VF8 exact T1.1 subtree parts with task and leftOut, T1.2 text; empty H1 fallback text, metadata title empty, run.title = spec id, TUI bold fallback; older header from its own part metadata; Ops metadata type (tsgo), taskOps parts: input.parts plus behavioural session/prompt metadata test, no SessionPrompt import; run.task for T1.2 and absent for whole spec. Runs: core-command 50/50, -t header 5/5, fault-folders 7/7, prompt.test 59/60 (the fail is a non-T4.10 3000 ms timeout under load; passes alone with the T4.10 case 2/2), tui routes 6/6, tsgo clean in opencode and tui. Notes: journal/task/T4.10-verify.md.
